Dubai Culture and Arts Authority reveals details of the artistic programme for the 31st International Symposium on Electronic/Emerging Art (ISEA2026), which Dubai is hosting until 15 November under the theme 'ELYAH: Constellating Place, Data and Identity'. The programme features more than 100 artistic showcases across over 20 locations throughout Dubai, including installations, performances and interactive experiences by creatives from around the world. The Dubai Government Excellence Programme, part of the General Secretariat of The Executive Council of Dubai, commences the first phase of its 2026 assessment cycle. The cycle covers eight Dubai Excellence Medal categories, two variable categories comprising Best Joint Government Initiative and Best People of Determination-Friendly Entity, and a Special Tribute for Unknown Soldiers. A total of 35 assessors, organised into 10 teams, will evaluate nominations against the approved criteria for individual and institutional excellence.
